status's 74 row: read failure, not stat alone

summary: flume status returns 74 on a loop.pid or tip claim that is present and unreadable, not a raw stack and 1
acceptance: Every present-but-unreadable file status must read prints a `[flume] status:` line naming it and exits 74; no read in the verb escapes to main().catch.
tests: flume status exits 74 when loop.pid is present but cannot be read
flume status exits 74 when the tip claim is present but cannot be read
flume status --help names exit 74 for a claim file that cannot be read
notes: Verified on disk: a directory at either path exits 1 with a raw EISDIR stack (src/cli.ts:348 liveLoopClaim, :409 liveTipClaimPid — both called outside the existsLoud try that returns EX_IOERR). Each reader throws on non-ENOENT by contract; the classification is the verb's. --help rides along: it says "could not be stat'd" where docs/CLI.md already says "unreadable", and only the stat half is true today.
